requirements.text: They're looking for strong software engineers with experience in Python and/or C++, ideally from data-intensive, distributed or performance-sensitive environments. Prior financial services experience isn't essential.

The scope includes Python and C++ development, large-scale data processing, research tooling, model evaluation and performance-critical trading infrastructure. You'll be solving complex engineering challenges across both research and production environments, with a strong emphasis on scalability, reliability and performance.
